SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'CY' ELSE 'other' END yr,
 f.channel_code, f.channel_id, s.store_id>=900 AS pseudo, s.store_id=999 train, s.store_id=900 web, f.staff_purchase_flag sp,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('PY',DATE '2024-10-28',DATE '2025-01-26'),('CY',DATE '2025-10-27',DATE '2026-01-25')) t(yr,s,e)),
sl AS (SELECT p.yr, f.*, st.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e),
dup AS (SELECT yr, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dup_rc, count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dup_id, sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_bad, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badq, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL OR store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls FROM sl GROUP BY yr),
rt AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id=900 web, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) dl, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'dup' k, yr, dup_rc::VARCHAR a, dup_id::VARCHAR b, vat_bad::VARCHAR c, days::VARCHAR d, badq::VARCHAR e, nulls::VARCHAR f FROM dup
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', yr, web::VARCHAR, n::VARCHAR, dl::VARCHAR, refund_net::VARCHAR, orphan::VARCHAR, NULL FROM rt
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('PY',DATE '2024-10-28',DATE '2025-01-26'),('CY',DATE '2025-10-27',DATE '2026-01-25')) t(yr,s,e)),
sl AS (SELECT p.yr, f.*, st.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e),
dp AS (SELECT yr, count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dup_rc, count(*)-count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dup_id, sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_bad, count(DISTINCT sale_date) ndays, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badq, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL OR store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullcnt FROM sl GROUP BY yr),
rt AS (SELECT p.yr, st.store_id=900 isweb, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) dl, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END yr, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT business_date) nd, count(DISTINCT store_id) nstores, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gs, sum(returns_net) retn, sum(net_sales) ns, sum(CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) pseudo
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'dup' k, yr, dup_rc::VARCHAR a, dup_id::VARCHAR b, vat_bad::VARCHAR c, ndays::VARCHAR d, badq::VARCHAR e, nullcnt::VARCHAR f FROM dp
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', yr, isweb::VARCHAR, n::VARCHAR, dl::VARCHAR, refund_net::VARCHAR, orphan::VARCHAR, NULL FROM rt
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', yr, n::VARCHAR, nd::VARCHAR, nstores::VARCHAR, gs::VARCHAR, retn::VARCHAR, ns::VARCHAR||' pseudo '||pseudo::VARCHAR FROM rp
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store),
sales AS (SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END yr, st.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag sp, f.net_amount amt
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'),
sl AS (SELECT yr, sum(amt) a_all, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 THEN amt END) a_notrain, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 AND NOT sp THEN amt END) a_nostaff FROM sales GROUP BY yr),
rets AS (SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END yr, sum(r.refund_net) rn, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<>999 THEN r.refund_net END) rn_notrain
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sl.yr, a_all, a_notrain, a_nostaff, rn, rn_notrain, a_all-rn net_all, a_notrain-rn_notrain net_notrain FROM sl JOIN rets USING(yr) ORDER BY 1

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE region END AS region_label FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id <> 999),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, st.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key)
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'CY' WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' END AS yr, c.region_label, amt
  FROM lines l JOIN cur c USING (store_id)
)
SELECT region_label AS region,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'CY' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26_q3,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'PY' THEN amt END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25_q3,
  round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'CY' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'PY' THEN amt END) - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM tagged WHERE yr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_label ORDER BY region_label
